authority: docs/marketing/brand-assets/logos/README.md — the Owner's usage rules are preserved verbatim there; this file is the machine contract that consumes them.
absolute_rule: The creative generator NEVER redraws, regenerates, approximates, typesets, hallucinates or reconstructs the Advantage.Bid logo when a logo treatment is required. The system may choose WHICH approved variant to use; it may not redesign the logo. A typeset 'Advantage.Bid' is not a logo treatment (the footer band wordmark is a locked brand-frame text element, not a logo).

asset_registry.approval: Only files listed here are authoritative. New files in the folder are NOT authoritative until the Owner identifies them and they are added to this registry (README 'Future Assets').

use: where a white rectangle would interfere
backgrounds with sufficient contrast (light or neutral)

variants.ground: transparent — for dark navy, dark photographic areas, dark panels
use: navy band (when a logo, not the wordmark, is wanted there)
square or near-square placements where the full logo would be too small
never: as a substitute for the full logo when there is room and full identity matters

inputs: placement zone background luminance and busyness (measured under the intended logo box)
rules: Advantage.Bid-led creative, light/neutral zone → primary_transparent over a light ground (or primary_horizontal when the zone is pure white); the white rectangle of primary_horizontal must never sit visibly over a photograph or coloured ground.
Zone luminance < 0.45 or busy photograph under the box → white_horizontal, and the zone must be darkened/quieted by layout (a navy panel or a clean dark area), never by editing the logo.
Available width < 22% of canvas width → ab_icon is NOT the answer for an ad; re-layout to make room. ab_icon is for avatars/compact placements only.
Co-brand (Professional Seller-led): the Advantage.Bid mark in the relationship line uses primary_transparent (or white on the band) at 60–90% of the seller identity weight (3P.1 prominence rules).
When uncertain, prefer the approved primary variant with the strongest legibility that does not overwhelm the campaign hierarchy (README).

compositing_stage.position_in_pipeline: creative composition → merchandise/environment → typography → layout → [LOGO STAGE: choose variant → reserve clear space → composite actual asset] → prominence/legibility QA → alteration check
compositing_stage.reserved_zone: the layout reserves a logo box (width band per prominence rules; clear space ≥ 1× logo cap height) BEFORE generation; the generator is told the box is off-limits (no text, no merchandise, no rendered logo) and the box is masked to the ground colour after generation before compositing
transform_forbidden: stretch, skew, rotate, crop, recolour, opacity < 100% (except a documented watermark use), drop shadows or outlines added to the asset, tagline removal or substitution, adding a campaign slogan inside the asset
compositing_stage.slogans: 'The Smarter Way to Sell.' / '…to Shop.' are separate text elements placed near the logo with their own clear space; never baked into the asset; the asset's own tagline GET THE ADVANTAGE stays as-is (REF-21 shows the slogan drawn where the tagline sits — production does not do that).
compositing_stage.hash_check: the composited pixels are compared to the registered asset at the placed scale (normalised cross-correlation ≥ 0.97 inside the box); a mismatch fails QA

qa.prominence: 3P.1 prominence-rules.json applies unchanged; Advantage.Bid-led lockup width band widened to 30–50% of canvas width (REF-15/16/18–22 sit near 50%).
qa.alteration_check: template match of the registered asset inside the logo box ≥ 0.97; OCR of the box must read ADVANTAGE.BID and (for full variants) GET THE ADVANTAGE; any extra text inside the box → fail
qa.rendered_logo_detector: OCR + template search over the whole render for 'ADVANTAGE.BID' strings or gavel-like marks outside the logo box (e.g. on a laptop screen, a mug, a box): a rendered logo anywhere else → fail (README: replace with an approved asset — in practice regenerate with the object surface blank or remove the object); a rendered logo INSIDE the box is masked and replaced by the asset
qa.fail_action: REGENERATE the layout with the logo box enlarged/relocated; never shrink the headline first; never scale the logo below the band minimum

reference_library_note: Every 3P.2 reference carries an image-model rendering of the logo. Sidecar field logo_treatment_in_reference records it. The principle extractor never emits 'logo style' lessons; the only logo lesson is placement zone and prominence.
